name: Kopia
description: Kopia is a fast, encrypted and deduplicating backup tool. In server mode it offers a web UI for snapshots, policies and restores, and serves repositories to remote Kopia clients over HTTPS.

app_vars.name: var_kopia_password
app_vars.label: Web UI Password
app_vars.help: Password for the admin user of the web UI. Generated when empty

app_vars.name: var_kopia_repo_password
app_vars.label: Repository Password
app_vars.help: Encryption password of the default repository. Generated when empty, cannot be recovered if lost

notes.text: Open https://IP:51515 and accept the self-signed certificate. The UI and repository passwords are in /opt/kopia_data/.env; keep the repository password safe, without it the backups cannot be decrypted.
The default repository lives on the container disk in /opt/kopia_data/repository. For real backups connect a repository on a mount point, NAS or S3/B2 storage from the UI.
Remote Kopia clients need a user from `kopia server user add` and the certificate fingerprint of /etc/ssl/kopia/kopia.crt.
